permissions: retain user-authored plan drafts in page memory until unload
submit one user-authored task prompt to the current regular root session after a direct Run now click; that prompt inherits every tool permission already granted to the root session

submit one natural-language request asking the current regular root session Agent to use schedule_create after a separate Schedule click; the plugin cannot require, constrain, or verify which tool the Agent calls
network: direct: authenticated in-origin Session Controller prompt admission to the selected regular root session only
indirect: the admitted prompt may use any network-capable tool already granted to that root session
processes: indirect: the admitted prompt may use any process-capable tool already granted to that root session; the plugin starts no process directly
files: indirect: the admitted prompt may use any file-capable tool already granted to that root session; the plugin reads or writes no file directly

assertions.expected: The exact hosted package and Cordis entry occur once; every declared DeepSeek peer resolves to 0.1.2-alpha.2 and no removed aggregate runtime resolves.
A cold Web start reaches __DSH_BOOT_READY__; one footer trigger, one dormant overlay occupant, one owned style, and eight locale dictionaries are present.
The user can add and remove bounded one-shot, delayed, or interval plan cards; no plan causes a Host mutation, prompt, timer, or execution until a separate action button is clicked.

Run now submits exactly the selected self-contained prompt once through the current regular root Session Controller only after its direct user click, inherits that root session's already-granted tools, and reports admission failure without retry.

Schedule submits exactly one user-visible natural-language request asking the root-session Agent to use alpha.2 schedule_create with after_seconds, every_seconds, or offset at arguments; the plugin neither calls nor constrains a tool, cannot guarantee the Agent uses schedule_create, and never creates or drives its own timer.
Submission is refused unless sessions.current names an existing non-subagent session and sessions.currentAddress is absent; no subagent or addressed nested session is admitted.

The plugin itself has no direct Host service, storage, raw route, outbound request, credential, process, file, Agent or Session creation, direct tool call or tool constraint, automatic retry, background timer, or unattended prompt submission capability; an admitted prompt may still exercise network, process, or file tools already granted to the root session.

Dialog focus, Escape, labels, form controls, action buttons, narrow layout, 200 percent zoom, 12/14/17 pixel font settings, and light and dark schemes remain usable without clipping essential actions.

Removal aborts an in-flight admission and leaves zero plan state, slots, styles, locale dictionaries, package rows, client graph entries, or dependency-closure changes; governed Home and Profile bytes match the snapshot.

Both uniquely identified additive slots coexist with official sidebar, overlay, conversation, Schedule, settings, todo, and goal surfaces; full-batch rollback restores all prior entries after an injected later failure.
